figurative_meaning_en: The ear of a third person besides the speaker and the listener
example_sentences_in_bangla: এখানে ষট্কর্ণ থাকতে পারে, গোপন কথা বলো না।
ষট্কর্ণের ভয়ে আমরা চুপ করে কথা বললাম।
example_sentences_in_english: Be careful, there might be third ears around; don't speak secrets.
Out of fear of eavesdroppers, we spoke in hushed tones.
note: This idiom emphasizes caution in private conversations, reflecting traditional Bengali concerns about gossip and privacy.
